title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Reduce complexity of report datasets (Company information dataitem in Word layouts)
summary: Word report layouts in Business Central 2026 release wave 2 now include a shared Company Information dataitem across all report datasets, reducing developer effort and standardizing how company information is accessed in Word layouts.
key_points: Word layouts in BC29 automatically get a Company Information dataitem shared by all report datasets, with no need for the developer to define it
The dataitem shows up as CompanyMetadata under BCReportInformation and holds the Company Information details
It is there for custom reports and for standard reports, even when the layout is completely empty
It reduces report developer effort and standardizes company information use across layouts
Builds on BC26, which first exposed report and request metadata in Word layouts
features: Company Information dataitem in Word layouts

quotes.text: Word layouts now include a company information dataitem that is shared across all report datasets.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core feature - it standardizes company information access and reduces complexity for report developers
